registryEntry.label: Defender for Cloud at the free tier (Foundational CSPM)
registryEntry.set_command: foreach ($p in @('VirtualMachines','StorageAccounts','CloudPosture','Arm')) { $cur = Get-AzSecurityPricing -Name $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $cur -or $cur.PricingTier -ne 'Standard') { Set-AzSecurityPricing -Name $p -PricingTier 'Free' | Out-Null } }; Get-AzSecurityPricing | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('VirtualMachines','StorageAccounts','CloudPosture','Arm') } | Select-Object Name,PricingTier | ConvertTo-Json

metadata.commandExecuted: foreach ($p in @('VirtualMachines','StorageAccounts','CloudPosture','Arm')) { $cur = Get-AzSecurityPricing -Name $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $cur -or $cur.PricingTier -ne 'Standard') { Set-AzSecurityPricing -Name $p -PricingTier 'Free' | Out-Null } }; Get-AzSecurityPricing | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('VirtualMachines','StorageAccounts','CloudPosture','Arm') } | Select-Object Name,PricingTier | ConvertTo-Json
